visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women sit in green business-class airplane seats. The woman on the left wears a black tank top and a patterned bandana, while the woman on the right wears a dark blue tank top. They look at each other excitedly, holding white headphones over an open newspaper. (2) They both place the white over-ear headphones on their heads simultaneously, looking towards the camera with wide smiles. (3) A series of quick cuts shows them posing: first with arms crossed leaning back, then holding newspapers up to their faces, then with blue neck pillows leaning heads together. (4) One woman stands up and retrieves a large silver hardshell suitcase from the side, lifting it above her head as if loading a bin, while the other watches. (5) They both wave their arms in the air and smile broadly, celebrating the empty cabin.
